searchText: <@!364458974906548225> Anything I can do to help facilitate 4byte.directory getting its certificate issue fixed? I have a little tool that uses it via API and it is currently broken due to the TLS certificate tissue. I almost had it this afternoon but ran into some certbot issues and then got rate limited. Should have it back up tonight or tomorrow morning (if it is not back up by mid day us time tomorrow you can help by pestering me about it one more time) should be back up now and I got a cronjob setup that should autorenew my cert going forward.
